title: What is the average math score of the school with the lowest average score
question: What is the average math score of the school with the lowest average score for all subjects, and in which county is it located?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    T1.AvgScrMath,
    T2.County
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN SchoolInfo AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY 
    (T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite) / 3 ASC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql: SELECT T1.AvgScrMath, T2.County FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN SchoolInfo AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND T1.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND T1.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrWrite) / 3.0 ASC LIMIT 1
